source.title: Hugin - Maverick Smith
source.name: Hugin
source.description: A Support capable of enhancing allies and wielding an anvil.

skills.name: Unstoppable!

description.raw: Passive. Hugin sets his anvil on the tile where he is placed during battle preparation. As his normal attacks and skills require the anvil, he will remain near it throughout the battle and will always return to it if displaced. Active. Hugin forges a Gear of Might for the ally dealing the highest cumulative damage, boosting their combat strength. The gear increases the ally's ATK by 6% + 1% (SP-based) of Hugin's base ATK and increases their Haste by 80 for 10s.
passive: Hugin sets his anvil on the tile where he is placed during battle preparation.
As his normal attacks and skills require the anvil, he will remain near it throughout the battle and will always return to it if displaced.
active: Hugin forges a Gear of Might for the ally dealing the highest cumulative damage, boosting their combat strength.
The gear increases the ally's ATK by 6% + 1% (SP-based) of Hugin's base ATK and increases their Haste by 80 for 10s.

skills.description_lite: Hugin increases the ATK and Haste of the ally with the highest cumulative damage dealt.

skills.name: Titan's Aegis

description.raw: Hugin crafts a cogshield for the weakest ally, allowing them to block 600% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based) damage for 8s.
active: Hugin crafts a cogshield for the weakest ally, allowing them to block 600% (ATK-based) + 60% (SP-based) damage for 8s.

skills.description_lite: Hugin grants a shield to the weakest ally.

skills.name: Mechanized Bond

description.raw: When a battle starts, Hugin etches a mechanical sigil one tile behind him, granting ally on this tile an ATK bonus equal to 14% + 2% (SP-based) of Hugin's base ATK. The buffed ally recovers an extra 75 Energy whenever Hugin casts Titan's Aegis. This buff disappears when the ally leaves the sigil.
active: When a battle starts, Hugin etches a mechanical sigil one tile behind him, granting ally on this tile an ATK bonus equal to 14% + 2% (SP-based) of Hugin's base ATK.
The buffed ally recovers an extra 75 Energy whenever Hugin casts Titan's Aegis.
This buff disappears when the ally leaves the sigil.

skills.description_lite: Hugin increases the ATK of the ally 1 tile behind him. The buffed ally also recovers Energy whenever Hugin casts Titan's Aegis.

skills.name: Steelbound Kinship

description.raw: Hugin crafts enhanced cogshields for the 2 weakest allies when casting Unstoppable!, granting each with a shield that blocks 800% (ATK-based) damage for 8s.
active: Hugin crafts enhanced cogshields for the 2 weakest allies when casting Unstoppable!, granting each with a shield that blocks 800% (ATK-based) damage for 8s.

text: Grants control immunity to allies protected by an enhanced cogshield while it's active.

skills.description_lite: When casting Unstoppable!, Hugin grants shields to the 2 weakest allies.

skills.name: Enhance Force Hugin

description.raw: While the cogshield or enhanced cogshield is active, the protected ally also takes 30% less damage.
active: While the cogshield or enhanced cogshield is active, the protected ally also takes 30% less damage.

skills.description_lite: While active, the shield Hugin grants also reduces the protected ally's damage taken.
